snippet.title: Knockout 2: Wrath of the Karen - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
SAVE THE WORLD — As an FBI agent, research a terrifying disease spreading across the country in this classic Punch-Out!!-inspired game. However, a much darker, older secret lurks in the shadows, and an ancient evil rises to threaten national security, the world, and your quarterly performance bonus.

Releasing on Steam, Android, and iOS in 2026!
